data.gender_notes: Hasrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A feeling of longing or yearning for something, often used to describe the love and devotion for Allah. The name Hasrat carries the meaning “Desire or Wish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasrat usually hope their child will grow to embody desire or wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islam, Hasrat is a state of being that is pleasing to Allah, where one's heart is filled with love and longing for His mercy and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Hasrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire or Wish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasrat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: حسرت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسرت ایک ایسا جذبات ہے جو انسان کو کسی چیز کی کمی محسوس کرата ہے، Islam میں حسرت کو مختلف معنوں میں لیا جاتا ہے، جہاں یہ ایک مثبت جذبات ہو سکتا ہے جو انسان کو اپنے 目標 کی طرف لے جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हसरत
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसरत एक ऐसा भावना है जो मनुष्य को किसी चीज की कमी महसूस कराता है, इस्लाम में हसरत को विभिन्न अर्थों में लिया जाता है, जहां यह एक सकारात्मक भावना हो सकता है जो मनुष्य को अपने लक्ष्य की ओर ले जाता है

in_pashto.name: حسرت
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسرت دا یو احساس دی چې انسان ته څه څیز لکه پاتې کوي، په اسلام کې حسرت ته بېلابېل معناګانې ورکړل شوي دي، چېرې چې دا یو مثبوت احساس وي چې انسان ته د هغه موخې ته راوړي
